description: BYOK. Requires an API key: South Korean public-procurement AWARD results (who won which bid) from the Public Procurement Service successful-bid records, multi-year, not just the last 12 months. Pass your own free Korean public-data-portal (data.go.kr) service key as _apiKey; there is no platform key. Get one free by registering at https://www.data.go.kr and applying for the Public Procurement Service successful-bid information service. Filter by procurement type (goods, services, construction), award date window (max 31 days per call), notice number, winner-name text and notice-title text. Returns per award: notice number and title, buyer, winner name and business number, award amount in KRW, award rate, number of bidders, opening date. Example: korea_get_awards({ type: "services", from: "2024-03-01", to: "2024-03-31", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your own data.go.kr service key. korea_get_awards requires an API key; there is no platform key. Register free at https://www.data.go.kr and apply for the Public Procurement Service successful-bid information service; the key is issued under My Page. Either the encoded or decoded form of the key works.

notice_no.description: Look up one bid notice number instead of a date window.

page.description: Upstream page, 1-based (each page is up to 100 records before the winner/title filter).

title.description: Keep only awards whose notice title contains this text (Korean).

to.description: Award window end, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 31 days after from).

winner.description: Keep only awards whose winner name contains this text (Korean, as registered).

name: korea_get_awards
title: Korea Get Awards
